articles.title: Alaska jellyfish UFO mystery takes bizarre turn as experts reveal what was spotted near US military base
articles.summary: A bizarre jellyfish-shaped UFO spotted hovering over Alaska has sparked speculation about possible alien visitors, but experts believe the mysterious object may have a far more ordinary explanation.
articles.title_cn: 阿拉斯加水母状UFO之谜出现离奇转折，专家揭示美军基地附近目击真相
articles.summary_cn: 一个在阿拉斯加上空盘旋的怪异水母状不明飞行物引发了外星来客的猜测，但专家认为这一神秘物体可能有一个更为普通的解释。
articles.body_cn:
近日，一段在阿拉斯加拍摄的水母状不明飞行物视频在网络上引发热议。视频显示，一个带有下垂触须状结构的物体悬停在安克雷奇附近的埃尔门多夫-理查森联合基地（Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson）附近上空，该基地驻扎有F-22猛禽战斗机。目击者称，该物体在空中停留约三分钟后突然消失，未留下任何痕迹。

这一画面迅速引发关于外星访客的种种猜测。然而，专家对此持谨慎态度。有分析人士指出，从物体的形态和运动特征来看，它很可能并非什么超自然现象，而是某种人造物体——例如商业销售的水母造型风筝。有网友表示，曾看到有人牵着类似风筝的线。

不过，目击者萨拉·简·奥斯本（Sara Jane Osborn）对此说法并不认同。她表示，该物体的运动方式“明显不像风筝”，而且她和丈夫事后在附近区域搜寻了约半小时，并未发现任何放风筝的人。她还指出，附近公园面积狭小，不适合放飞如此大型的风筝。

目前，该物体的真实身份仍无定论。专家表示，在缺乏更多数据和独立验证的情况下，对此类目击事件应保持理性分析，既不排除普通解释，也不宜过早下结论。

articles.title: Department of War Issues New UAP Disclosure Waiver; But Similar Protections Already Existed
articles.summary: The Department of War announced September 14, 2026, that it has issued a targeted legal waiver allowing current and former military personnel, civilian employees and contractors to provide protected information concerning Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) directly to designated representatives of the government’s PURSUE effort. articles.body:
The Department of War announced September 14, 2026, that it has issued a targeted legal waiver allowing current and former military personnel, civilian employees and contractors to provide protected information concerning Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) directly to designated representatives of the government’s PURSUE effort.
According to the Department, the waiver establishes an “authorized, legally protected disclosure mechanism” for individuals possessing UAP-related National Defense Information, or NDI.
“This waiver establishes an authorized, legally protected disclosure mechanism for current and former personnel to provide UAP-related National Defense Information (NDI) to designated representatives of the PURSUE effort,” the Department said.
The announcement is significant, particularly because the Department expressly references Special Access Program Indoctrination Agreements alongside conventional nondisclosure agreements.
But the underlying concept, allowing government personnel to provide otherwise protected UAP information to specifically authorized government investigators without violating their NDAs, is not new.
Documentspreviously obtainedand published by The Black Vault show that similar protections were already established for disclosures to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO). Those protections became a central issue during AARO’sunsuccessful attemptsto interview former intelligence official David Grusch in 2023.
The new announcement therefore raises an important question: What does the PURSUE waiver provide that the government did not already provide through AARO?
The public announcement does not fully answer that question.
According to the Department of War, the new directive covers “all current and former DOW service members, civilian personnel, and contractors holding or previously granted access to UAP-related National Defense Information.”
Those individuals are now authorized to provide that information directly to official PURSUE representatives.
The Department specifically states:
“The waiver supersedes civil and administrative enforcement provisions contained within Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and Special Access Program Indoctrination Agreements (SAPIAs) previously executed within the United States, strictly for communications directed to the PURSUE team.”
That final limitation is important.
The announcement does not provide blanket authorization for personnel to disclose protected information publicly. It does not state that classified information may be provided to journalists or released independently by the individual possessing it. Nor does the announcement itself declassify information.
The authorization described by the Department applies specifically to disclosures made to PURSUE.
According to the Department, information entering that channel would undergo “systematic review, security evaluation, and potential declassification.”

articles.title_cn: 战争部发布新的UAP披露豁免令，但类似保护措施早已存在
articles.summary_cn: 战争部于2026年9月14日宣布，已发布一项有针对性的法律豁免令，允许现任和前任军事人员、文职雇员及承包商直接向政府PURSUE计划的指定代表提供有关不明异常现象（UAP）的受保护信息。据该部门称，该豁免令建立了一个“授权”机制。
articles.body_cn:
战争部于2026年9月14日宣布，已发布一项有针对性的法律豁免令，允许现任和前任军事人员、文职雇员及承包商直接向政府PURSUE计划的指定代表提供有关不明异常现象（UAP）的受保护信息。

据该部门称，该豁免令为持有UAP相关国防信息（NDI）的个人建立了一个“获得授权、受法律保护的披露机制”。

“该豁免令为现任和前任人员建立了一个获得授权、受法律保护的披露机制，使其能够向PURSUE计划的指定代表提供与UAP相关的国防信息（NDI），”该部门表示。

这一宣布意义重大，尤其是因为该部门在常规保密协议之外，还明确提到了特殊访问项目保密宣誓协议。

但这一基本概念——允许政府人员在不违反保密协议的前提下，向特定授权的政府调查人员提供原本受保护的UAP信息——并不新鲜。

The Black Vault此前获取并公布的文件显示，针对向全域异常解决办公室（AARO）披露信息的类似保护措施早已建立。这些保护措施在2023年AARO试图约谈前情报官员大卫·格鲁施（David Grusch）未果的过程中成为核心问题。

因此，这一新宣布引出了一个重要问题：PURSUE豁免令提供了哪些政府此前通过AARO未曾提供的保护？

公开声明并未完全回答这一问题。

据战争部称，新指令涵盖“所有现任和前任战争部服役人员、文职人员及承包商，凡持有或此前曾获准接触UAP相关国防信息者”。

这些人员现已被授权将这些信息直接提供给官方……

articles.title: Navy Releases Massive Cache of Scott Bray UAP Emails After Four Years; More Than 300 Pages Withheld in Full
articles.summary: The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort. The records were obtained by The Black Vault [...] The post Navy Releases Massive
articles.body:
The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort.
The records were obtained by The Black Vault through a Freedom of Information Act request filed on May 24, 2022. The request sought emails sent to, from, copied to or blind-copied to Bray containing terms including “Unidentified Aerial Phenomena,” “UAP,” “UAPTF,” “UFO,” “AATIP,” “AAWSAP” and several related phrases.
More than four years later, the Navy responded on September 23, 2026. According to its response, the search located 1,321 pages of responsive records. The Navy withheld 302 pages in their entirety, while releasing the remaining 1,019 pages with redactions under several FOIA exemptions.
Bray served as Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence and Director of the Naval Intelligence Activity during much of the period covered by the records. His position placed him within a network of Navy, Defense Department and Intelligence Community officials dealing with UAP reporting, briefings, congressional interest and the development of what ultimately became the Navy-led Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force.
One email in the release described the relationship directly, stating that John “Jay” Stratton “leads the UAP Task Force effort for Navy… working directly for Scott Bray, our Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence.”
Bray later became one of the government’s most visible officials on the UAP issue. On May 17, 2022, he appeared with Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security Ronald Moultrie before a House Intelligence subcommittee during a public congressional hearing devoted to UAP. The hearing was followed by a classified session.
The newly released records provide a much larger documentary backdrop to that public role.
A Broad Look Behind the Government’s UAP Effort
The correspondence stretches across years and includes exchanges involving Stratton, Defense Intelligence official Neill Tipton, senior Navy officials, admirals, Pentagon public-affairs personnel and other Defense and Intelligence Community officials.
For example, a March 2020 exchange shows Tipton, who was then identified in his signature block as Director of Defense Intelligence, Collection and Special Programs in OUSD(I&S), telling Bray that he had a document “relevant to our discussion the other day” that he preferred to deliver in hard copy. Other correspondence concerning a planned Senate Select Committee on Intelligence briefing includes Bray, Stratton, Tipton and Rear Adm. Kelly Aeschbach.
Elsewhere, the records show Stratton discussing proposed public language concerning the UAP effort and whether it should be reviewed by Bray before being sent forward. Other email traffic includes Vice Adm. Matthew Kohler, Rear Adm. Charles Brown and Rear Adm.
articles.title_cn: 海军四年后公布斯科特·布雷UAP邮件大批文件，逾300页被全文扣留
articles.summary_cn: 海军部公布了超过1300页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷（Scott W. Bray）的邮件及相关记录，为了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期围绕不明空中现象的政府通信打开了一扇广阔的窗口。这些记录由The Black Vault获取……
articles.body_cn:
海军部公布了超过1300页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷（Scott W. Bray）的邮件及相关记录，为了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期围绕不明空中现象的政府通信打开了一扇广阔的窗口。

这些记录由The Black Vault通过2022年5月24日提交的《信息自由法》申请获得。该申请要求提供发送给布雷、由布雷发送、抄送或密送布雷的邮件，其中包含“不明空中现象”“UAP”“UAPTF”“UFO”“AATIP”“AAWSAP”及若干相关短语。

四年多后，海军于2026年9月23日作出回应。根据其回复，检索共找到1321页相关记录。海军将302页全文扣留，其余1019页在依据多项《信息自由法》豁免条款进行删减后予以公布。

布雷在记录所涵盖的大部分时期内担任海军情报局副局长兼海军情报活动主任。他的职位使他处于一个由海军、国防部和情报界官员组成的网络之中，负责处理UAP报告、简报、国会关注以及最终发展为海军主导的不明空中现象工作组的相关工作。

公布的一封邮件直接描述了这一关系，称约翰·“杰伊”·斯特拉顿（John “Jay” Stratton）“领导海军UAP工作组的工作……直接向我们的海军情报局副局长斯科特·布雷汇报”。

布雷后来成为政府在UAP问题上最引人注目的官员之一。2022年5月17日，他与国防部情报与安全副部长罗纳德·莫尔特里（Ronald Moultrie）一同出席众议院情报小组委员会一场专门针对UAP的公开国会听证会。听证会后还举行了机密会议。

新公布的记录为这一公开角色提供了更为宏大的文献背景。

纵观全局……

articles.title: What is the Electronic Reading Room?
articles.summary: Welcome to the Central Intelligence Agency's Freedom of Information Act Electronic Reading Room.
articles.summary_cn: 欢迎来到中央情报局《信息自由法》电子阅览室。
articles.body_cn:
电子阅览室是美国中央情报局（CIA）依据《信息自由法》（FOIA）设立的在线公开平台，用于向公众提供已解密和可公开的政府文件。该平台是公众、研究人员和记者获取情报机构历史档案的重要渠道之一。

根据《信息自由法》的要求，联邦机构须将经常被申请查阅且已向申请人公开的记录上传至电子阅览室，供所有人平等获取。中情局的电子阅览室收录了大量解密文件，涵盖历史情报报告、备忘录、研究报告等，其中也包括与不明飞行物（UFO）和不明确空中现象（UAP）相关的历史档案。

对于UFO/UAP研究领域而言，电子阅览室长期被视为重要的原始资料库。研究者可通过关键词检索，查阅冷战时期以来涉及空中异常现象、目击报告及相关调查的政府文件。不过，并非所有文件都会公开，部分内容仍因国家安全等原因被全文或部分扣留。

articles.title: Sara Jane Osborn films three-minute Jellyfish Ufo near JBER
articles.summary: Sara Jane Osborn filmed a jellyfish ufo near Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson on June 15. The object hovered for three minutes before vanishing.
articles.title_cn: 萨拉·简·奥斯本在JBER附近拍摄到三分钟水母状UFO
articles.summary_cn: 萨拉·简·奥斯本于6月15日在埃尔门多夫-理查森联合基地附近拍摄到一个水母状不明飞行物。该物体悬停约三分钟后消失。
articles.body_cn:
据目击者萨拉·简·奥斯本（Sara Jane Osborn）描述，6月15日，她与丈夫皮特（Pete）在阿拉斯加安克雷奇附近的埃尔门多夫-理查森联合基地（Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson，JBER）一带度假时，偶然拍摄到一个形态怪异的不明飞行物。当时两人停下车拍摄彩虹，奥斯本注意到天空中有一个不寻常的物体。

她起初以为那是一只蚊子，但随后发现该物体呈水母状，下方垂着数条长长的触须状结构。她随即拍摄了多张照片并录制了视频。据其丈夫估计，该物体距离他们约三英里，但其实际大小和距离均无法确认。

奥斯本表示，该物体在空中悬停约三分钟后“几乎在出现的同时就消失了”。她强调，从运动方式来看，该物体“明显不像风筝”，而且夫妇二人在附近搜寻约半小时，并未发现有人放飞风筝。

JBER基地驻扎有F-22猛禽战斗机。目前，该物体的真实身份尚无定论，相关视频已在网络上引发广泛讨论。

articles.title: Mysterious ‘Jellyfish’ UFO Spotted Near Alaska Military Base Vanished Without A Trace, According To Witness
articles.summary: Extraterrestrial Spaceship Alien Jellyfish UFO A woman on vacation with her husband in Alaska filmed a strange, jellyfish-shaped UFO hovering next to a ...
articles.body:
A woman on vacation with her husband in Alaska filmed a strange, jellyfish-shaped UFO hovering next to a U.S. military base. The object appeared to have several long tentacles dangling below it, then suddenly vanished.
The mysteriousUFO sightingoccurred near Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Anchorage,Alaska, home to F-22 Raptor fighter jets. Sara Jane Osborn and her husband, Pete, had stopped to take pictures of a rainbow when she saw something strange in the sky.
“I was annoyed, because I was like, is that a mosquito?”  Osborn recalled, according to theInternational Business Times.
What she was looking at turned out to be much more interesting than a mosquito, so shetook more photos and recorded a video. Her husband estimated the object was about three miles away, but the UFO’s actual size and distance are only guesses.
“It was gone almost as soon as it had appeared,” she said.
Was The Mysterious Jellyfish UFO Just A Kite?
According toNDTV,some viewers said the object looked like a commercially available jellyfish-shaped kite. One person even reported seeing someone holding the string of a similar kite.
However, Sara Jane Osborn said, “It was very clearly not a kite in its movements.”
The couple reportedly spent about 30 minutes searching the area for someone who might have been flying a kite, but found no one.
She also wondered whether a kite so big could even be flown in the nearby park. “It’s a very small park. You can’t operate a large kite from that park,” she remarked.
She also said she is familiar with the vibrant kites flown over the city’s parks because she has lived in Anchorage for many years. This wasn’t one of those.
Osborn proposed that “only God and the government” might know what theUFOactually was. “Because it was there, and then it wasn’t. I can’t deny that it happened,” she said.
Asone person on Xpointed out, “There’s a VERY easy way to prove this ‘UFO Jellyfish’ is actually just a kite… The kite flyer can chime in… If a person had this intricate, expensive and huge kite…and just happened to fly it through a gorgeous rainbow… They surely took a pic or video from their pov. So…let’s see it and put this whole thing to rest.”
This Isn’t The First Jellyfish UFO To Make Headlines
In January 2024, investigative filmmaker Jeremy Corbell releasedvideo of another jellyfish-shaped UFOreportedly recorded over a U.S. military base in Iraq in 2018.
Corbell claimed the object was not visible to standard night-vision equipment. He also said witnesses saw it plunge into a body of water before shooting back up in the sky.
ThePentagon later responded to questionsabout the footage, declining to comment on the legitimacy of the purported leaked Defense Department material.
More recently, adowned American fighter pilot described Iranian dronesflying in a formation that looked like a jellyfish. That sighting, however, involved suspected military drones, not a mysterious flying object.Or a kite.
articles.title_cn: 目击者称阿拉斯加军事基地附近神秘“水母”UFO消失得无影无踪
articles.summary_cn: 一名与丈夫在阿拉斯加度假的女子拍摄到一个怪异的水母状UFO悬停在……旁边。
articles.body_cn:
一名与丈夫在阿拉斯加度假的女子拍摄到一个怪异的水母状不明飞行物悬停在一座美军基地旁边。该物体下方似乎垂着数条长长的触须，随后突然消失。

这起神秘UFO目击事件发生在阿拉斯加安克雷奇的埃尔门多夫-理查森联合基地（Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson）附近，该基地驻扎有F-22猛禽战斗机。萨拉·简·奥斯本（Sara Jane Osborn）与丈夫皮特（Pete）当时停下车拍摄彩虹，她注意到天空中出现了奇怪的东西。

“我当时有点烦，心想，那是只蚊子吗？”奥斯本回忆道，据《国际财经时报》报道。

她看到的东西显然比蚊子有趣得多，于是她拍了更多照片并录制了视频。她的丈夫估计该物体距离约三英里，但该UFO的实际大小和距离只能靠猜测。

“它几乎在出现的同时就消失了，”她说。

神秘水母UFO只是风筝吗？

据NDTV报道，一些观众认为该物体看起来像市面上销售的水母造型风筝。甚至有人称看到有人牵着类似风筝的线。

然而，萨拉·简·奥斯本表示：“从它的运动方式来看，非常明显不是风筝。”

据报道，这对夫妇花了约30分钟在附近搜寻可能放风筝的人，但一无所获。

她还质疑，这么大的风筝能否在附近公园放飞。“那是个很小的公园，你没法在那个公园里放大型风筝，”她说。

她还表示，由于在安克雷奇居住多年，她对城市公园里放飞的那些色彩鲜艳的风筝很熟悉。这次看到的并不是那种东西。

奥斯本提出，“也许只有上帝和政府”才知道那个UFO究竟是什么。“因为它在那里，然后又不见了。我无法否认这件事发生过，”她说。

正如一位网友在X平台上指出的那样：“有一个非常简单的方法可以证明这个‘UFO水母’其实只是风筝……放风筝的人可以出来说句话……如果有人拥有这个精巧的……”
